verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official Auth0 CLI for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks, and fitting into development and deployment workflows, hosted in its own GitHub repo. The changelog also lists an "Agent Mode for the Auth0 CLI", which speaks directly to AI-native use. missing for 10: detailed documentation of what Agent Mode does, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agentic workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Learn how to use Auth0 CLI to manage your tenant configuration, automate tasks, and integrate Auth0 into your development and deployment workflows.
